text.rootboot.restart_required: Changes take effect only after restarting the game or server.
option.rootboot.time_offset.tooltip: Starts new worlds on day 1 by adding one day at world creation. Affects only worlds created afterwards; existing worlds are never changed.
option.rootboot.day_announcement.tooltip: Shows the global Overworld day on the action bar at dawn and when joining a world.
option.rootboot.level_milestone.tooltip: Plays a local animation when your experience level crosses a multiple of 5. Visible only to you and never triggered by level decreases.
option.rootboot.homing_experience_orb.to: Makes experience orbs pursue the nearest non-spectator player within 64 blocks after a short delay.
option.rootboot.crops_experience.tooltip: Harvesting a fully grown crop without Silk Touch has a chance to drop one experience point: 75% for wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, cocoa and nether wart, 100% for melon and pumpkin. Fortune changes nothing.
option.rootboot.death_item_protection.to: Prevents items dropped on death from despawning over time. They remain vulnerable to fire, lava, explosions, cacti, the void, and other hazards.
option.rootboot.death_stats.tooltip: Announces every death to everyone online with the time the player survived since their previous death and their total death count, taken from the vanilla statistic. The survival time advances only while the player is connected and alive.
option.rootboot.biome_discovery.tooltip: Shows a local title the first time you enter each vanilla or modded biome.
option.rootboot.major_event_discovery.to: Shows a local title the first time you enter the End and the first time you come within 64 blocks of any Wither. Each discovery is recorded once per player and never repeats.
option.rootboot.half_health_babies.toolt: Halves the effective max health of any baby mob, composing with modifiers from other mods. Disabling it restores the full max health of existing babies as they are loaded.
Gives each armor piece a piglin is born wearing a chance of coming out trimmed: 25% outside bastions and 50% inside them, rolled once per piece at spawn. Piglin brutes and unarmored piglins are never trimmed, and piglins a world already has are left alone.
option.rootboot.extra_loyal_tridents.too: Keeps a trident enchanted with Loyalty from being destroyed by the void. It waits below the world while its owner is dead, offline or in another dimension, and the vanilla return takes it back once the owner is available again in the same dimension.
option.rootboot.heavyfoot.tooltip: Enables the Heavyfoot effect on enchanted boots.
option.rootboot.heavyfoot_radius.tooltip: Size of the square area affected around the block you occupy: 0 affects 1x1, 1 affects 3x3 and 2 affects 5x5.
option.rootboot.lightfoot.tooltip: Enables the Lightfoot effect on enchanted boots.
option.rootboot.jukebox_music_override.t: Suppresses ambient music while a jukebox is playing a disc within 64 blocks, whatever the jukebox volume is set to. The vanilla scheduler resumes once no disc is playing nearby, without resuming the interrupted track.
option.rootboot.local_death_sound.toolti: Plays a sound only you can hear when you die, chosen by what killed you. Damage types without a mapping, including modded ones, use a generic sound.
option.rootboot.stop_music_on_death.tool: Interrupts your own ambient music when you die. Jukeboxes and every other sound keep playing.
option.rootboot.low_health_sound.tooltip: Plays a heartbeat only you can hear when a non-fatal hit lowers your real health to four hearts or less. Absorption does not raise the threshold, and a fully absorbed hit stays silent.
message.rootboot.major_event.end.title: THE END
message.rootboot.major_event.end.subtitl: A sky without stars opens above you
message.rootboot.death_stats: %s survived %s since their last death and now has a total of %s deaths
message.rootboot.death_stats.first: %s survived %s since spawning into the world and now has a total of %s death
